policy.note: Forge owns the entire user-facing vocabulary. GSD is never addressed directly and is never edited or copied — it is invoked in place so upstream fixes arrive for free. This registry is the single boundary where GSD's structured command emissions become Forge verbs.

delegation_modes.contain: Forge spawns a subagent that reads and follows the stock GSD workflow on disk and returns a structured result. The transcript never reaches the user, so GSD's own command strings cannot leak.
delegation_modes.relay: The workflow is interactive and cannot be black-boxed. Forge relays each question in game-dev framing and passes answers back down, translating any action identifier it surfaces.
delegation_modes.native: Forge owns the behaviour outright. No GSD workflow is involved.

verbs.adaptation: Forge reads gsd_run smart-entry directly and adds adoption, runtime, and capability routing.
